$comment: Provider contract and provider-home resolution purity. Only shared provider-home resolvers read configuration-home variables or assemble home-relative provider config paths. Exceptions describe provider-specific behavior that is not config-home resolution. New violations and stale exemptions fail.

entries.removedBy: Retain while Claude Keychain service suffixes hash the raw configured value, not the resolved absolute folder. This read selects credentials; the folder still uses the shared resolver.
Remove when support for the legacy ~/.claude/local/claude executable installation ends. The binary location is independent of CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.
Retain while Grok scans the fixed ~/.claude/plugins compatibility registry independently of the Claude profile. Changing this path would change Grok discovery behavior.
Retain while omp uses PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR with its own ~/.omp/agent default and profile precedence. This resolves omp configuration; its Pi compatibility root uses the shared Pi resolver.
